author: Lethamyr
description: Description Using cube balls in rocket league, I’ve created a brand new game mode in Rocket League based on the game Cornhole! Take turns throwing bean bags onto the board, at the end of all 8 throws, add up points and the team with more points gets the difference in points in score. Bean bags in the hole = 3 points, bean bags on the board = 1. If you scored 5, and the opponents scored 3, you get 2 points. You have to score exactly 11 to win! Going over means you lose those points. Recomm...

author: Lethamyr
description: This sumo map is the first of potentially many sumo maps that introduce moving objects you have to maneuver around to survive!

name: Fractals Corridor
author: fractalrl
description: 1.5x SCALED UP version of Labs corridor

name: Gladiator
author: Lethamyr
description: Gladiator is a unique form of Tug of War, where you battle against the opponent to push the ball through the rings and score in the final goal at the back of the field. The white rings don’t do anything, only the blue and orange rings push the goal further away! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Time: Unlimited Rumble, Boomer, or Spike Rush are also fun!

name: Rubii Ruins
author: Aceman3000
description: A ruby-themed standard map

name: Half-Size
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League, but half the size! This map can destroy your brain, but it’s super fun! You can mess with the ball size to make the ball fit to scale, or mess with car scale to try and play at hyper-speed. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: DFH Cliffside
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League racing, one-way this time! Introducing DFH Cliffside, where it’s a race to the top of the hill. There are pitstops for fun relay races if you want to mix it up, otherwise the fastest to the final tunnel wins! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited or Recharge Demo: Disabled Rumble can be interesting! Just use Demo Derby

name: Random Goal Locations - Arabian Nights
author: Lethamyr
description: Rocket League, but the goal could literally be anywhere!

description: Intenta encestar la pelota

name: Blackout

description: Welcome to The Blackout!

description: Randomized goals

name: Rocket Labs: Escape Game
author: Ecrase-Patate
description: A Rocket League escape room solo experience

name: Basketball Court
author: Lethamyr
description: This basketball court features 3 basketball nets on each team, elevated from the floor. The outer nets grant you 2 points per goal! Be careful not to get stuck in the rafters, or on the balcony! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Time: Unlimited Rumble or Boomer (why not both?) is also quite fun!

name: Shuffleboard
author: Lethamyr
description: Play shuffleboard with your friends in Rocket League! Spawn in the puck and slide it down the track to try and score as many points as you can! Feel free to make up your own rules to make it more fun for your group. Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited Ball Type: Puck

name: RINGs OF DEATH
author: Zen15
description: rings pakour

name: Pitch Black
author: Lethamyr
description: Rocket League but everything except the ball and cars is completely invisible! Try not to get lost. The ball color definitely helps keep an idea of where the ball is in the field. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: Shattershot
author: Aceman3000
description: I put a dropshot tile in the goal hehe

name: Senju City
author: fractalrl
description: Standard map in a city on fire inspired by Senju

name: Heatseeker Dungeon
author: Lethamyr
description: A standard map with a re-colored Heatseeker ball! I had this as a game mode before Rocket League officially put Heatseeker in as a mutator. Enjoy playing Heatseeker in a different environment! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: Wave Race
author: Lethamyr
description: Rocket League racing… on a jetski??? Yep, I finally finished a project I started 2 years ago. This is Rocket League Wave Race, challenge your friends to the most unique race in Rocket League to date, and try not to hit too many barrels! Maneuver your way the best out of your friends to win! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited Boost Strength: 1.5 or 2x Demo: Disabled Rumble can be interesting! Just use Demo Derby mutator

author: CommunistCowboy
description: Long boy hoops map

description: Standard map by SimpleShark

name: The Real Boomer Mode
author: ThundaSurge
description: This is a multiplayer stadium. Play with your friends either 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, or 4v4. EVERYBODY needs Bakkesmod Net Code Plugin (#166) in order to BOOM. Press the "Use Item" button to BOOM. BOOM next to the ball. BOOM next to other players. Recommended game settings: Respawn Time - 1 second Also try boomer mode settings for more fun. My personal favorite was heavy ball.

name: Air Hockey Table
author: Lethamyr
description: The puck (or ball) spawns on top of the bridge, and there is a barrier between the two halves of the map to divide players. If you shoot the puck (or ball) through the underpass, the velocity of the puck will be boosted! I plan on recreating this map in a polished, proper air hockey style! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Ball Type: Puck Ball Size: Large Ball Bounciness: Low

description: Panic's Air Race, by Panic

description: 10 dribble levels each increasing in difficulty through a forbidden island themed map!

name: Duality
author: the_cartiste
description: A Dropshot map with 3 goals on each side of the field with opportunities for both teams to score on either side of the map.

name: Dribble_2_Overhaul
author: luchibald
description: Dribble_2_Overhaul

name: Fractals Futura Garden
author: fractalrl
description: Fractals version of Futura Garden

name: Squash Court
author: Lethamyr
description: Play Squash with a Rocket League ball! The court is to scale, and plays out just like the game in real life. Serve above the middle red line, and the possession changes when the ball hits the back wall. A ball is out if it touches any yellow parts of the wall! 1 bounce is allowed before a player or team loses the round. Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited Ball Physics: Light Goal Reset: Disabled

name: Smash Bros Sumo
author: Lethamyr
description: Smash Bros. meets Rocket League!

description: UPDATED VERSION OF PROP HUNT: Disguise your car as a prop and try to avoid getting caught! This map is the first prop hunt map I created. You can choose a variety of medieval props to hide on 4 different floors of the castle. Once you get caught, you swap teams and help find the rest of the props! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited Demo: On Contact

description: This is a rocketleague map but it's a motor... yeap!

description: At Long Last!

name: Clock Tower
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Welcome to the Rocket League Clock Tower! This map is a giant re-imagination of the inside of a giant clock tower, with moving gears. The clock ticks to each second, but the gear teeth don’t affect the ball or car to avoid any collision issues. Boomer is super fun on this one! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer Settings are very good

name: Angry Balls
author: Froyo
description: Defeat the pigs to free the eggs.

name: The Apex - Barrage

description: Volleyball by Derzo and MrPhil

name: Medieval Chainball
author: Lethamyr
description: A medieval version of Chainball!

name: The Elements
author: Lethamyr
description: This 6-month project combines the 4 basic “elements” into one giant map: Earth, Water, Air & Fire.

name: F-Zero Big Blue
author: Lethamyr
description: Race through a classic Nintendo racing stage!

name: Battlegrounds
author: Lethamyr
description: Welcome to the battlegrounds! This map is 7 nearly-standard maps glued together. Probably one of the funniest maps I’ve created, even though it’s quite glitchy at the intersections of each map. You may find yourself getting sucked through a wall here or there, but it’s worth it. Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Score Limit: First to 1 Goal Boost: Unlimited

name: Skyscraper
author: Lethamyr
description: Another classic battle map from Mario Kart 64, turned into a standard map in Rocket League! The 4 goals are in the colored openings of the skyscraper. You can come up with your own game modes or play free for all with 4 different colors! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer ball is also quite fun!

description: Trolling on steroids

name: Giant Pinball Table
author: Lethamyr
description: Insert the ball into the coin slot to start the game. Use your car to control the flippers and launch the ball. See how high of a score you can get! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited

name: Whirly Tanks
author: Lethamyr
description: Welcome to the FIRST installment of Whirly Tanks!

name: Shipment
author: Lethamyr
description: I brought Call of Duty into Rocket League by recreating the Shipment map we all know and love! The goals are inside the open shipping containers on each team’s side. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Ball Max Speed: Fast Ball Physics: Light Ball Bounciness: High

author: zachakaquack
description: Up and Down - Made by zachakaquack - Bottom half is regular gravity, top half is inverted. (Note - the steering is a bit f*cked on the inverted gravity) CREDITS: Me (zachakaquack): Creator CommunistCowboy: Gave me the idea for TeamPaint texture (the neon orange and blue texture) Ecrase-Patate & MrPhil: Project Bibliotheque-Delaxandrie https://discord.com/channels/711882968200904715/787121766241271838/915003455083528272 Mr. Swaggles: Helping me out with uploading to steam workshop shout...

name: Capture the Flag Winter
author: Lethamyr
description: This map is a re-skin of my first Capture the Flag for Beyond the Summit! Bring the opponent’s ball to your zone while your ball is home to score a point! Feel free to choose what score to reach!

name: Triple Goal
author: Lethamyr
description: This is my very first map creation. I was testing models and the basics of Rocket League custom maps. There are 3 goals on each side of the field, and that’s all there is to it! The ball MAY disappear randomly… Did I mention this was my first creation ever? Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: Hoops Stadium
author: Lethamyr
description: Hoops meets Throwback stadium! I’ve created 2 bowls and placed them inside an oval-shaped Rocket League field. The map is exactly what you’d expect: score in the bowl to win the game! A lot of fun in any team size, so go for it! Recommended Settings Game Mode: Hoops Boost: Unlimited

name: Crossroads
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Similar to the old Octagon map, there are 4 goals in the outer edges of the map, but I’ve cut in the sides creating a cross-shape in the map. Quickly change from defense to offense and have quick transitions between sides. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: Jungle Gym Sumo Night
author: Lethamyr
description: The night version of Jungle Gym Sumo.

name: Minute To Win It
author: fractalrl
description: Speed through the course and score the ball into the logo to beat the map! From 7/19 8AM EST to 7/26 8PM EST there will be a $100 Prize Pool to the fastest time to complete the map! Good luck and happy speedrunning!

name: Break the Bank
author: Lethamyr
description: Collect points by getting the ball through your colored rings and bring the ball to your color's bank! If a goal is scored, the collections reset. At the moment, it's set to first to 100, but set whatever points you want as a cap. Recommended Settings Boost Amount: Unlimited Spike rush is not required but is a lot of fun!

name: Luigis Mansion
author: Lethamyr
description: Luigi’s Mansion is an old race track from the Mario Kart series! This map is great as a race map in 2 different ways. Either as a driving race, or using the Ghost Hunt balls to try and push your ball around the racetrack first! This can get quite competitive! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited Ball Type: Ghost Hunt

name: Block Fort Sumo
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League Block Fort, but this time with lava! Challenge your friends to a game of Sumo, and feel free to use demolition derby rumble powerups to make it feel more like balloon battle! We had a lot of fun playing on this one. Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Recharge Slow Demo: Disabled Rumble: Demolition Derby

name: Capture the Flag Sandcastle
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This map is the second concept of Rocket League Capture the Flag! Bring the opponent’s ball to the top of your castle zone while your ball is home to score a point! Feel free to choose what score to reach! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Score Limit: You choose Boost: Recharge (slow or fast) Rumble: Spike Rush

name: Hexagon 2v2v2
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This map was designed to be a larger 3-team map, intended for 2v2v2. The goals are GIGANTIC, so enjoy as you betray your friends in this large open field. My sister (iamKikira) designed the models for this one! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer mode and Rumble is pretty fun

name: Pod Racing
author: Lethamyr
description: Rocket League racing has leveled up, now with brand new vehicles!

name: Minute 2 Win It
author: fractalrl
description: 2nd Installment of the minute to win it series! SPONSORED BY SOLACE PATH!

name: Mario Kart Racing: Yoshi Circuit
author: Loading
description: Fully realized racing mode with Mario Kart item boxes

name: The Apex - Convergence
author: MrSwaggles
description: Galley-Oops by Mr. Swaggles

name: Prop Hunt
author: Lethamyr
description: Disguise your car as a prop and try to avoid getting caught! This map is the first prop hunt map I created. You can choose a variety of medieval props to hide on 4 different floors of the castle. Once you get caught, you swap teams and help find the rest of the props! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited Demo: On Contact

name: Popshot
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League Dropshot… but on the ceiling instead?! This map was a lot of fun to create, and a lot of fun to play! Pop the ball into the ceiling to open up the tiles, and shoot it into an open tile to score! Recommended Settings Game Mode: Dropshot Slight boomer or rumble can be helpful!

name: Quake Sumo
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League Quake Sumo is another addition to the Sumo series of maps I’ve made, but this one runs a little differently. Instead of only having 1 life, this is instead a Team Deathmatch mode where every time you fall off the edge, you give the other team a point on the scoreboard. Battle with your friends or 1v1 your rival and see how you do! Recommended Settings Time: 10 or 20 Minutes Demo: Disabled Rumble: Demo Derby

name: Stack
author: CommunistCowboy
description: Drop to the bottom floor to score!

name: Soda
author: CommunistCowboy
description: Coke v Pepsi

name: Kuxir Height Wall
author: Boinkrl
description: Try to hit the golden goal!

name: Portal Floor Stadium
author: ThundaSurge
description: *Host will need Map Expansion Plugin for map to work!!!* (#294) First team to score 30 goals wins. Use the following settings when playing this map. Match Length - Unlimited Boost Amount - Unlimited Feel free to use any other mutators that you want, my personal favorite is Boomer mode settings with super fast ball speed. Shout out to SimpleShark for reviewing my Kismet and optimizing it.

name: The Apex - Shatter
author: MrSwaggles
description: Wallbreaker by glhglh

name: Pinbal34
author: CountryMo
description: You might get angry at little things, change the file from .udk to .upk, I forgot

name: Giant Foosball Table
author: Lethamyr
description: This map takes Standard Rocket League and places it on regular foosball table!. Scoring is just like normal, except the ball has to fall into the floor of the goal! The figures on each teams’ side can get in the way, causing some unique moments. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Ball Speed: Fast Ball Physics: Light Ball Bounciness: High

name: Boardwalk
author: Lethamyr
description: The goals of this map are atop a boardwalk that splits off in 4 ways in the center. This map was built from the skeleton of my Water Polo map, and I created a series of boards to drive across and mess around. Warning: Don’t smash into the boardwalk too hard, you might just break it ;) Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer can be fun!

name: Helium Ball
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League, but the ball is weightless! Enjoy a ball with zero gravity in my standard dungeon map. This will mess with your brain, gauranteed, but it’s still a lot of fun! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Slight boomer or rumble can be fun!

name: Capture the Flag
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This map has been requested for so long, and it’s finally a reality! Welcome to Rocket League Capture the Flag! Bring the opponent’s ball to your zone while your ball is home to score a point! Feel free to choose what score to reach! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Score Limit: You choose Boost: Recharge (Slow) Rumble: Spike Rush

name: Jungle Gym Sumo Day
author: Lethamyr
description: Welcome to the Rocket League Jungle Gym!

name: Paris Night
author: fractalrl
description: Paris remake at night!

author: fractalrl

name: Neo Tokyo Haxxelerator
author: MrSwaggles
description: As seen at AGDQ 2025

name: Hexagon Hoops
author: tjbrother
description: Play hoops in a world that destroys itself. Recommended Settings - Unlimited Boost Notes - Edges are hard to deal with. If you turtle, you will clip the edges. - Hexagons disappear 1 second after touching them.

name: Knockout Mushroom Kingdom
author: MrPhil
description: Knockout in 2D on a map from Super Smash Bros (Nintendo 64).

name: Dual Pinball Tables
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This map is a 1-to-1 scale of 2 pinball tables connected together. The ball is the exact size a ball would be inside an arcade pinball machine, and this map is as ridiculous as you’d think. Score in the ball return to win! I highly recommend boomer settings/rumble. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer Settings Rumble: Civilized

name: Uplink
author: Lethamyr
description: Description The idea of this map is that there are 6 towers that you need to transfer power to the center console. Send the ball through each zone to activate the tower, and once all 6 zones are cleared, the goal opens up in the middle to score. Recommended Settings Time: 10+ Minutes Score: First to 1 Goal Boost: Unlimited

name: Garrison
author: Lethamyr
description: Welcome to a brand new type of game mode I’ve created that I’m calling Garrison.

name: The Apex - Colossus
author: MrSwaggles
description: Big Hoops by Mr. Swaggles

name: Pyramids
author: Lethamyr
description: A standard field hidden away in the Rocket League desert, this map features bumpy sand dunes with pyramids scattered inside a giant map! Try to keep control of your car in the air, and avoid getting stuck on the ground! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer and Rumble are great on this map!

name: The Ring of Fire
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This map is the first of possibly many inside a brand new Rocket League Circus tent I created. This map features 2 ramps with a ring of fire in the center of the field, hanging from the ceiling. Don’t worry! The flames won’t hurt the cars. Score in the colored end of the ring to score a point for your team. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer mode is pretty fun

name: Medieval Bumperball
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This is a Medieval rendition of a custom Rocket League map made by Yoshilus. Bumperball features 3 goals on each end, but the middle is worth 6 points and resets the kickoff, meanwhile the outer 2 are only worth 1 point and give possession to the team that conceded. Give it a go with spike rush! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Rumble: Spike Rush

name: Dice
author: Lethamyr
description: Score in the holes of dice to gain points!

name: Fractal Field
author: fractalrl
description: slightly taller standard map with my logo as the goals!

name: The Apex - Vertigo
author: MrSwaggles
description: The Tall One by MissMacho

name: Christmas Snow Hill
author: Lethamyr
description: I created this map for 2019 Christmas, taking a ski-hill design and creating a sloped standard Rocket League field. The most difficult part to make in this map was the outer detail. Definitely one of the brighter and cheerier maps I’ve created! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: 4-Square
author: Lethamyr
description: A childhood favorite during recess, 4-square is here in Rocket League! The ball has to fall below the floor to score, feel free to keep tally of individual points or cycle around with a king of the hill! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Ball Physics: Light Do unlimited time if you’re doing lives or king of the hill.

name: Forest
author: Lethamyr
description: Description I created this map to help Mr. Beast with his #TeamTrees project last year to plant 20 million trees! This map is an interpretation of a standard map overrun by the environment, and has some quirky features inside that make controlling the ball… uh… well, difficult. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer ball is also quite fun!

name: The Hive
author: Lethamyr
description: This new game mode was started a year ago by myself, and recently Mr. Swaggles joined me to do a lot of the final details. We worked together for countless hours to create a brand new field that has a unique feel and look. You pair up with teammates in opposite rooms to repair your own team colored room, while stopping the other team from repairing in theirs.

name: Mario Bros
author: Lethamyr
description: Description I took the classic Mario Bros. game and stuck it inside Rocket League! Playing in a 2D platformer in a 3D game isn’t the most elegant, but I did my best to make the game feel like the original. You can hit the POW to send the players and ball up in the air. The top pipes are 3 points, the bottom pipes are 1 point. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer ball is recommended. Rumble doesn’t quite work with ball targets or player targets since the camera is too far away.

name: Dueling Snakes
author: Lethamyr
description: Rocket League with a goal the size of the ball!

name: Capture the Flag - Candyland
author: Lethamyr
description: Capture the Flag: Candyland edition!

name: Whirly Tanks 2
author: Lethamyr
description: Welcome to the second installment of Whirly Tanks!

name: Chains
author: CommunistCowboy
description: Try to score while chained up!

name: The Apex - Overpass
author: MrSwaggles
description: Highland Loop by Trinal

name: The Apex - Gradient
author: MrSwaggles
description: RMP Arena by Nickster

name: Easter Catwalk
author: Lethamyr
description: This map was created for Easter of 2019, collaborated by myself and Glhglh, a well-known map maker! This map has 2 goals on top of a catwalk in the center of the field, and the outer sides of the field have boost in the grass. How many golden eggs can you spot outside the field? Recommended Settings None

name: Rapid Fire
author: Lethamyr
description: Inspired by Hungry Hungry Hippos, I created a 4-player (or 2-team) ball collection game mode! There are 3 different ball types: Standard Ball: 1 Point Dropshot Ball: 2 Points Heatseeker Ball: 5 Points Score the most before the time runs out! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited Spike Rush is very fun on this map!

name: Beach Brawl
author: Lethamyr
description: Description I took Water Polo and the Rocket League Throwback Stadium and put them together into a mash-up of land and water gameplay! The goals are at the edges of the water pool. I suggest using Rumble but it’s not necessary, definitely adds some fun aspects to it though! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Ball Type: Beach Ball

name: Cant Get It Up
author: CommunistCowboy
description: You may try, but you will fail.

name: 1/400 chance for a Withered Foxy jumpscare every second
author: Aceman2000
description: pretty self explanatory

name: Crossroads
author: the_cartiste
description: 1v1 or 2v2 possession-score map - the ball-chaser's dream!

name: mapa guloso
author: Gustavo_br758
description: gulosinhos da silva

name: The Apex - Prominence
author: MrSwaggles
description: Cross Bridge by Leth

name: Funnelball by Drumitch
author: Skillquest
description: Ever wanted to play on a map where the goal is funnel-shaped? Well now you can! This map has a high ceiling, 4 curved pillars, and goals shaped like funnels to make playing Rocket League as chaotic and crazy as possible!

name: Feverdream Volleyball
author: MrSwaggles
description: I dreamt this map on day 2 of whatever plague I've been dealing with for a week straight. Siiick!

name: Original Sumo
author: Lethamyr
description: This is the first of many Sumo maps I’ve created! This map is a simple sumo map with a single circular platform to battle with your friends! Be the last one standing! Team battles are also quite fun. We usually give points equal to the number of players left on a team that survived. Go to whatever point cap you want! Recommended Settings Boost: Recharge Slow Time: Unlimited Demo: Disabled

name: Mayan Pitz
author: Lethamyr
description: Designed after an old historic game with rings on the wall. Score through the rings with the ball to win! This game was in Road to El Dorado, one of my favorite cartoon movies as a kid! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: Water Polo Remastered
author: Lethamyr
description: UPDATED VERSION OF WATER POLO: This map was originally created by Glhglh, but I remastered it to work in the current state of the game. The goals are suspended halfway up the sides of the field at a waterline. The ball and cars will float in the water, so prepare to lose control of your car as you bounce around the field! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Feel free to experiment with other settings like boomer!

name: Volcanic Eruption
author: Lethamyr
description: Description The fourth edition of my Rocket League Sumo series! This time around, beware of the active volcano that will erupt at random moments, sending every player high into the sky! Make sure to save enough boost to recover and avoid being bumped mid-air! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Recharge Fast

name: Standard Dropshot
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Standard Dropshot is probably my most polished map to date. This is the ultimate combination between Standard Rocket League and Dropshot, including both the regular goals, as well as Dropshot tiles along the entire floor. The boost pads exist and float on the floor, but the ball won’t collide with them! Recommended Settings Game Mode: Dropshot

name: Sumo Cagematch
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Technically this is the 6th map to join the Sumo Series of maps, but in this version it’s all about demolitions! Be the last one standing to win. Feel free to experiment with demo on contact, or play a skillful match of full-speed demos! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Recharge Fast Demo: Friendly Fire (or Contact FF)

name: Quicksand Sumo
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League, but with Quicksand! Welcome to another addition to the Sumo series on my site. There are 4 islands with pyramids you can climb and hide from your friends. Don’t fall into the quicksand though! This one is a ton of fun with demo derby settings (use the custom rumble plugin to customize powerups on bakkesmod) Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Demo: Disabled Rumble: Demo Derby or custom powerups plugin

name: Medieval Jousting Sumo
author: Lethamyr
description: Description We jump into the land of medieval Rocket League, but this time around we’re jousting! This is a 1 on 1 game mode where you actually wear a giant lance as you try and knock your opponent into the water. Careful of the thin platform! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Demo: Disabled Rumble: Demo Derby or custom powerups plugin

name: Arabian Nights
author: Lethamyr
description: A brand new Standard arena set in the Middle East!

name: Donut Dropshot
author: Lethamyr
description: Dropshot in a circle this time!

name: Shroomo
author: CommunistCowboy
description: Rocket League on Shrooms

name: The Apex - Crucible
author: MrSwaggles
description: Hoops Stadium by Leth

name: Galleon_TNT
author: CountryMo
description: Galleon map but outside, with TNT around that changes position after each goal Huge thanks to Leth's tweet for letting me know that the galleon already existed in game, the one I was modelling was pretty ugly. LeeroyJenkinsOG, Shark and Ecrase-Patate, you gave me so many ideas and solutions that pushed me to keep trying, so thank you! If something isn't working properly, please let Ron know, actually just tell it to me😁 Barrel tutorial I followed https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M...

name: Water Polo
author: Lethamyr
description: This map was originally created by Glhglh, but I remastered it to work in the current state of the game. The goals are suspended halfway up the sides of the field at a waterline. The ball and cars will float in the water, so prepare to lose control of your car as you bounce around the field! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Feel free to experiment with other settings like boomer!

name: Underwater Goals
author: Lethamyr
description: This map is difficult. That is all. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Time: Unlimited You may want Boomer or Rumble!

name: Inside Out
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League but it’s inside-out! I put the goals in the middle of the field this time around, which leads to some pretty cool interactions above and around the goals. Very fast-paced action! Definitely on the more polished side of most of my maps. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: The Bubble
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Welcome to the Rocket League Bubble, the 5th installment of the Sumo Series! This map features a ring around the outside, with a giant bubble in center floating above. This bubble has zero gravity! Tread carefully, and try not to fall into the water! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Recharge Slow Demo: Disabled

name: Duality 2
author: the_cartiste
description: A Dropshot map with 3 goals (now in a different configuration) on each side of the field with opportunities for both teams to score on either side of the map.

name: Flash Freeze
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Welcome to Rocket League Flash Freeze! Every 15-30 seconds a random flash freeze will occur, stopping the ball’s motion for up to 3 seconds! There’s no moving that ball during that time, so try and time when it’s released! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: Slantshot
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League Dropshot… but on the slanted floor this time around! Don’t worry if the ball is completely black, it’s intentional. For “some” reason, Rocket League really doesn’t like Dropshot tiles being on an angle, so I had to do some voodoo magic to make this one work, and the end result is a black ball. But this map is really fun with Boomer mode! Recommended Settings Game Mode: Dropshot Slight boomer or rumble are great!

name: Broken Bridge
author: Lethamyr
description: Description The Broken Bridge is one of the first maps my sister (iamKikira on Twitch) designed. Originally the map was just the field, but together we came up with an interesting concept and look by incorporating the field into a split bridge. Playing on a slanted surface isn’t the easiest thing, so I recommend boomer settings for this one. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer Settings are very good

name: Graverobber Day
author: Lethamyr
description: This is simply the Day version of last year’s Halloween map!

name: Cross Bridge

description: Labs-style Rocket League with a giant bridge in the middle!

description: Hit the ball down on the opponents side

name: Standard Garrison
author: Lethamyr
description: This is a standard spin on the mode I created called Garrison! Keep the ball in the opponent’s half to take away their HP. Test your friends’ offense!.

name: Airship
author: Lethamyr
description: This is the third installment of the Sumo Series, this time with fans that launch you into the air! There are elevated platforms that you can hide away and collect boost, but be careful of falling off! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Demo: Disabled

name: Graverobber
author: Lethamyr
description: Description In this spooky Rocket League map, enjoy a bit of a spin-off of standard gameplay with goals that open up in the floor! Score in the standard net to open the opponent’s graves, and score in the open hole to win! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: Giant Easter Egg
author: Lethamyr
description: This standard Rocket League map variant was created by my sister, and it features 3 different platforms suspended inside a giant Easter egg! This map is a ton of fun with Boomer or Rumble, and helps with reading strange ball bounces.

name: Horseshoe
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This map was designed by my sister (IamKikira on Twitch) and she created a vertical horseshoe with goals in the very bottom of each end. There are platforms mid-air where the ball and cars spawn on kickoff. Is luck on your side in this map? Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Boomer mode is STRONGLY recommended

name: Rocket Labs Revolver
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This map was an attempt at making a similar map to Rocket League’s own labs map, Loophole. Definitely one of my favorite projects based on how clean the map is. There are 3 goals (holes in the floor) for each team with a pillar in the center. Score in any of the 3 goals to score points! I’ll be making variations of game modes on this map soon. Recommended Settings Standard gameplay works just fine on this map!

description: This is a Medieval rendition of my older custom Rocket League map, Hoops Stadium.

name: Block Fort
author: Lethamyr
description: Block Fort was an original Mario Kart 64 Battle Arena, and I brought it into Rocket League! Each block fort has a cube goal on top, feel free to play free for all on this map, or team sides with yellow and red vs green and blue. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Score Limit: Your choice! Playing with lives is very fun

name: Hex Drop
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Hex Drop is the second of Dropshot maps I’ve created! This map is the sister to Inside Out, where dropshot goals are between the H-shaped middle area. There’s a window in the middle for the ball to spawn! Definitely puts a different spin on the classic Dropshot mode. Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited Score Limit: First to 1 Goal

name: Infinium Sumo
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League Infinium: the newest Sumo map on the block. This time around, there are gravity wells in the center which will make travelling over them quite difficult for you. The gravity is 10x as strong, so be careful trying to escape from your friends when they’re bumping you! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Demo: Disabled

author: JRsuhi
description: A rings map for my first donator Plumato There is a collectable section, tied with a parkour sections after! Can you find all 20 Bloons? Submit your speedruns to www.speedrun.com/plumring! Recommended settings: Freeplay

author: JRsuhi
description: Play Santa's Workshop escape room in Rocket League! Special thanks to RANKKY for helping me with this map Recommended settings: Freeplay

name: 2Fort
author: Lethamyr
description: 2Fort is a map from Team Fortress 2, and it’s HUGE! This map is made up of nearly 3000 models I had to individually import and texture, and took me around 300 hours to finish. With this in mind, the map is nearly 1GB in size and can cause crashes occasionally, but it’s still one of my favorite Hide n Seek maps to date. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Time: Unlimited

name: Miniature Pool Table
author: Lethamyr
description: A top-down Rocket League racer inside a classic style arcade. Honestly one of my favorite maps in terms of visual aesthetic, I really love the mood of this one. The race track has a couple shortcuts and MANY ways to get stuck! So be careful as you race around the map! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Demo: Disabled

name: Spaceship
author: Lethamyr
description: Explore the depths of an abandoned Spaceship, or hide with your friends! This map is gigantic, so I’ve provided 2 versions to help with peoples’ PCs if they find the full version reduces framerate. Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited

name: Dart Board
author: Lethamyr
description: Description The second addition to the Rocket League Arcade, the Rocket League dartboard joins the Pool Table Race as another fun mini game to enjoy with friends! Test your accuracy by spawning in darts (colored balls), and you can clear the board with the push of a button. Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Boost: Unlimited Boost Strength: 1.5x

name: Cargo Bay
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Rocket League in space! The ball behaves normally but the cars float in the “air” in the map! This makes it very difficult to control your car, so enjoy as you float around with your friends trying to hit the ball. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited

name: Sling Puck
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This map is based on a real-life board game where you use the elastic to get all of your pucks onto the opponent’s side… So I brought it to life in Rocket League! 5 pucks spawn on each side, be the first to clear all of the pucks to win the round! Recommended Settings Time: Unlimited Score Limit: You choose Boost: Unlimited

name: Air Hockey Remastered
author: Lethamyr
description: Description Anyone remember my VERY old air hockey map with the underpass in the middle and GIGANTIC goals in the back? Yeah… we don’t talk about that. Here is my brand new air hockey table with a working puck! Choose how fast you want the puck to move by messing with ball mutators! Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Ball Physics: Boomer mode is best for fast-paced action

name: Split
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This map takes standard Rocket League and splits it in half. Since the map is split in half, 2v2 is the minimum game mode for this map, and make sure to disable demos! Recommended Settings Team Size: 2v2+ Demos: Disabled

name: Air Hockey 4Team
author: Lethamyr
description: Description This is a variation of the Air Hockey Map I released in the Rocket League arcade, this time with 4 teams! There are corners which push the puck back into play. You decide rules on crossing sides or not! Lives are displayed on screen. Recommended Settings Boost: Unlimited Ball Physics: Boomer mode is best for fast-paced action
